column1: unclear if "report the software or programming language" simple means that reporting the name is sufficient
The question states software/language and models used, while the criteria only state software/language
We can use the keyword "software" to identify this question. It is suggested to provide a list of common software as example or for selection (i.e., STATA, Matlab, Python)

I would say that the software is not the most important; what matters is the details of the models used. If possible, include details such as the estimator of tau2 (DerSimonian, others), how the confidence intervals are calculated (parametric, non-parametric, etc.). This will have a much greater impact on the results than the software used, I believe.
